text:
Maria: quick FYI — a customer hit a streaming call that aborted with a 502 mid-stream and our Python SDK bubbled up a generic Exception. want to align on error shapes + where to attach the request id for triage.
Chen: which client(s)? we previously added RetryableHttpError but streaming disconnects still land in the fallback.
Sam: seeing this in python and node. main goals: map HTTP -> typed exceptions, include x-request-id on exceptions, and expose resume info for streams when server provides it.
Alex: mapping proposal (suggested):
- 401 -> AuthError (non-retry)
- 403 -> PermissionError (non-retry)
- 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable; honor Retry-After)
- 5xx (502/503/etc) -> TransientServerError (retryable)
- streaming mid-stream disconnect -> StreamInterrupted(resume_possible: bool, resume_token: str | null, last_event_index: int)
Maria: yes to that. also need a clear doc on which errors the SDK will auto-retry vs which the app must handle (idempotency concerns).
Chen: implementation note for Python: base exception should carry .status_code, .request_id and .retryable flag so callers can programmatically decide.
Sam: logging guidance: always emit a compact debug line that support can paste. e.g.:
```
RID: %s STATUS: %d ROUTE: %s ERR: %s\n
```
And in structured logs include request_id, route, status, token_count. Example logger usage:
```
logger.error("call failed", extra={"request_id": rid, "route": endpoint, "status": resp.status_code, "err": type(exc).__name__})
```
Alex: SDKs should normalize resume token semantics: return a ResumeToken object with .value and optional .expires_at. If server doesn't emit token, StreamInterrupted.resume_possible=False.
Maria: what's the preferred format for the resume token? currently server emits a JSON chunk {"resume_token": "..."} intermittently. SDK should parse and attach to StreamInterrupted.
Chen: agreed. also add last_event_index on StreamInterrupted so apps can dedupe if they re-emit events after resume.
Sam: retries: use exponential backoff + jitter for 5xx and 429. For streaming reconnects, back off with a larger cap and expose hooks so the app can opt out after N attempts.
Alex: quick Python sketch for exception shape:
```
class RedwoodError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, status_code=None, request_id=None, retryable=False):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.request_id = request_id
        self.retryable = retryable

class StreamInterrupted(RedwoodError):
    def __init__(self, message, resume_possible=False, resume_token=None, last_event_index=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(message, **kwargs)
        self.resume_possible = resume_possible
        self.resume_token = resume_token
        self.last_event_index = last_event_index
```
Chen: Node SDK should mirror fields: err.requestId, err.retryable, err.resumeToken, err.lastEventIndex. keep naming consistent across languages.
Maria: QA/PR plan: Chen opens a PR that adds fields to exceptions, implements mapping table, unit tests for mapping, and an e2e that simulates 502 mid-stream asserting StreamInterrupted with resume_possible flag and last_event_index. ping @Maria and @Sam when ready for review.
Chen: I'll open the PR today and reference issue #612. PR will include test coverage and a small README entry for the error contract.
Sam: after merge DevEx will draft a troubleshooting snippet for support: what to ask (RID, model, payload size, token counts), how to read single-line debug, and suggested retry knobs.
Alex: small UX ask: include a one-line human-friendly message on exceptions (short) plus full details accessible on attributes. that helps in logs without dumping objects.
Maria: good call. Chen please add that to the checklist.
Chen: checklist I'll include in the PR description:
- add request_id to all raised SDK exceptions
- implement HTTP->exception mapping per table
- expose ResumeToken object when present
- set StreamInterrupted.last_event_index and resume_possible correctly
- add unit + e2e tests (mapping + streaming resume)
- update changelog & small docs snippet

deploy-bot: sdk-ci: run started for branch/chen/error-mapping (build 987).
Maria: thanks everyone — i'll review the PR once CI passes. :thumbsup:
